findings.message: Skill allows unbounded resource consumption (API calls, storage, compute). Without rate limits or quotas, a compromised or misbehaving agent can cause denial-of-service or cost overruns.
findings.remediation: Set explicit rate limits, timeouts, and resource quotas for API calls, file operations, and compute. Implement circuit breakers for runaway loops.

findings.message: Tool parameters are crafted to achieve unintended or unsafe behavior. Parameter abuse can bypass intended safety checks (e.g. shell=True, --force, dangerous glob patterns).
findings.remediation: Validate all tool parameters against an allowlist. Reject dangerous parameter values (shell=True, --force, -rf /) and use safe defaults.

findings.code_snippet:
> **Advanced Cloud Run Deploys:** If you need features not exposed via `agentforge` flags, use `--dry-run` (or `-n`) to print the full `gcloud` command, copy it, and add additional arguments as needed.

> **Project Confirmation:** If the project is resolved automatically (not passed via `--project`), the command will prompt for confirmation in interactive mode. Since agents typically run in non-interactive mode, you MUST pass `--no-confirm-project` to proceed if you are relying on automatic project resolution.

findings.message: Skill enables autonomous high-impact decisions without human-in-the-loop verification. Critical operations (destructive commands, financial transactions, data deletion) should require explicit user confirmation.
findings.remediation: Add human-in-the-loop confirmation for destructive, irreversible, or high-impact operations. Never auto-execute commands that modify files, send data, or alter system state.
